This is my only field, so I need to grow enough maize to feed my family. I was able to get a small bag of fertilizer through the subsidy program, and I will use the hybrid seed I kept from last year. My wife and children will help with all the hoeing and weeding, so we do not need to hire any workers. We depend only on rainwater, and I do not buy chemicals for spraying because they are too expensive for a small food plot like this.
